MRNA.invalidation: A close below $197 cancels the bid and confirms the momentum unwind; a gap down through $186 on a failed headline validates full abstinence. $186 is a trigger-level stop treated as a level, not a guaranteed fill

MRNA.reevaluation: Re-evaluate if the unknown August catalyst or the rate picture clarifies before any fill; a Q3-2026 seasonal revenue print above ~$800M or a positive pipeline readout (Merck PCV, CMV, flu/COVID combo) upgrades toward Overweight and re-prices the structure upward

P.invalidation: Stand down entirely on a close below 134; a close below the 140.14 breakout shelf impairs the thesis — Sell with no re-engagement

PENG.trigger: Entry only conditional on stabilization at $70-72 or $64-65 with volume re-expansion (a day that holds the zone, contracting down-volume, or a reclaimed prior high); half a standard allocation per tranche; skip the $64-65 tranche entirely if it arrives via a single waterfall day

PTC.trigger: Reassess only at regulatory milestones (US antitrust, EU merger review), on evidence confirming/disproving the reported absence of a termination fee, or on a confirmed deal break creating a dislocation far below $140 where fundamentals could make it a genuine long-term buy. Optional token ~$2,000 (2%) merger-arb sleeve as cheap optionality on a sweetened bid or competing acquirer

PTC.invalidation: Hard exit of any sleeve on a confirmed deal-negative headline or a close below $192 on elevated volume — a genuine break gaps through levels and cannot be stopped out
PTC.horizon: Until deal resolution (guided ~Q3 2027); token sleeve exited immediately on deal-negative headlines or close below $192
PTC.reevaluation: A meaningful termination fee or evidence of contested bidding upgrades toward Hold; a confirmed deal break far below $140 converts to a potential long-term buy on fundamentals; regulatory review materially tightening the spread confirms staying out
PTC.ambiguity: The only forward instruction is an optional token sleeve plus milestone-based reassessment — no standard entry/exit setup. Data quality thin (30-message sentiment sample, uncorroborated 'deal cancelled' rumor). A conditional half-sized short below $192 on expanding volume is flagged but rejected as a current action

QMCO.trigger: Re-engagement: a close back above ~$31 (10 EMA) on expanding volume, OR a filed second consecutive positive operating quarter with no new dilution confirmed via SEC filings — permits a half-sized long with a stop under ~$28.97-$28.30. QMCO.entry_convention: Stay flat — no long while price remains below the 10 EMA (~$31) and sell volume leads buy volume; do not press a short preemptively into twice-held $28.30 support (borrow unverified, unbounded downside in a 5x squeezer)
QMCO.invalidation: For holders: daily close below $28.30 exits the remainder — do not wait for the stop to fill well, the name can gap through (dilution filing or compliance notice could open it near $22)
QMCO.reevaluation: Before any position in either direction: check the 8-K on the CFO transition and SEC filings for outstanding or imminent dilutive offerings. A second consecutive positive operating quarter filed AND no dilutive offering removes the bear case's sharpest tooth
QMCO.ambiguity: Triggers exist in both directions (long re-entry above $31 on confirmation; downside re-evaluation below $28.30 gated on borrow verification and filings checks) — not a single publishable directional watch. Stop Loss field (28.3) is the exit line for existing holders, while the re-entry stop is stated as a zone (~$28.97-$28.30)
